propositions: Missing subpackage imports (e.g. git adapter in helpers) and scripts/ module import failures (e.g. alert_dedup without sys.path insert) escape the current wheel probe, which only runs top-level import and entry-point help
A deterministic import walk script must attempt all rebar.* modules via pkgutil and importlib, collect ALL failures without fail-fast, and report each with its traceback

Scripts/ modules require isolated child-process imports (self-reinvocation with scripts dir and CWD stripped from sys.path) to prevent one script's sys.path.insert from masking a sibling's missing insert
Optional-dependency modules (mcp, fastapi extras) must be attempted but recorded as skip only when the declared missing dep is absent; any other failure is a real failure

The walk must be locally runnable from a checkout (no CI dependency) and integrated as a one-line invocation in the wheel-probe step with regression tests proving it catches the pre-fix alert_dedup bare-import shape
